company_name: Any Hour Services - Electric, Plumbing, Heating & Air
parent_or_brand: Any Hour Group (backed by Knox Lane, San Francisco PE firm)
source: Knox Lane / PR Newswire press releases confirm Any Hour Group (Knox Lane-backed) expanded into Phoenix and Scottsdale, AZ under the Any Hour Services brand; company's own AZ site is anyhourservices.com/arizona

Company About page: founded 1993 by Steve and Deanna Mason (formerly 'Mason Mechanical'), family owned and operated in Chandler/Mesa AZ. The ZI flag matched an unrelated 'Mason Mechanical' in Las Vegas, NV -- false positive, no evidence of a link between the two

parent_or_brand: Reddi Services Inc. (Shawnee, KS) -- same family-owned company, not a separate local business
source: Company website (reddiservices.com/about-us) explicitly states it serves 'Kansas City Metro and Greater Phoenix Metro areas' as one family-owned company since 1957 that has consolidated several acquired local plumbing/HVAC businesses. The 'FRANCHISE/PARENT MATCH' flag is correct that it's the same company, but it is not PE-backed and not a franchise -- it's a direct multi-state branch of a family-owned business

Company About page: veteran-owned (Marine veteran 'Jesse'), Mesa AZ, in business 10+ years. The ZI flag matched an unrelated PA business ('Semper Fi Property Solutions' / 'Semper Fi Heating & Cooling', New Castle, PA, est. 2019) -- different owner, different company, false positive (both simply chose a common veteran-themed name)

parent_or_brand: Lee's Air, Plumbing, Heating & Roofing (CA-based multi-state company; same company as the Fresno-area entity, not a separate franchise)
source: leesair.com/acquisitions page shows Lee's has been the acquirer of several smaller CA companies (Mitchell Aire, Marthedal, Temp Pro, etc.) rather than being acquired itself, describing itself as independent since 1981. A press item shows a 'partnership' with LB Capital limited to launching a new roofing division (financing/training support), not an equity acquisition of Lee's. No PE ownership of Lee's itself was found

company_name: Ambient Edge Heating, Air Conditioning & Refrigeration Inc.
parent_or_brand: Friendly Group (backed by RFE Investment Partners)
source: Friendly Group press release 'Home Services Company Ambient Edge Acquired by Friendly Group' (May 2021); Friendly Group is confirmed backed by RFE Investment Partners per Friendly Group's own site and rfeip.com deal announcements. Founder Steve Lewis stayed on as GM post-acquisition

parent_or_brand: Friendly Group (backed by RFE Investment Partners)
source: Same entity/finding as C036 -- shares ambientedge.com domain and is part of the same Friendly Group platform covering Kingman, Lake Havasu City AZ and Henderson/Las Vegas NV

company_name: Rooter Hero Plumbing & Air of Tempe
parent_or_brand: Rooter Hero Plumbing Inc. (Mission Hills, CA) -- same multi-state company, owner-operated by founder John Akhoian
source: Company founder-message page and BBB profile identify John Akhoian as founder/owner (founded 2011); company itself is an active acquirer of other plumbing/HVAC firms (Allied Aire, Velavi Heating & Cooling, Specialty Contracting Group per Mergr/PrivSource). No evidence found of Rooter Hero itself taking PE investment

parent_or_brand: Service Experts LLC, owned by Enercare Home & Commercial Services, ultimate parent Brookfield Infrastructure Partners LP (NYSE: BIP)
source: Website is literally serviceexperts.com (not an independent domain), confirming this is a company-owned Service Experts location, not a locally owned business. Ownership chain confirmed via Brookfield Infrastructure Partners press release (2018 Enercare acquisition) and Service Experts' own 'Our History' page

parent_or_brand: Service Experts LLC, owned by Enercare Home & Commercial Services, ultimate parent Brookfield Infrastructure Partners LP (NYSE: BIP)
source: Same finding as C057 -- website is serviceexperts.com, confirming a company-owned Service Experts branch in Surprise, AZ, not an independent business

company_name: One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning® of Yuma
parent_or_brand: One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning franchise system, owned by Authority Brands (PE-backed by Apax Partners, with BCI minority stake)
source: Authority Brands' own 'Our Brands' page confirms One Hour is one of its franchise brands (since 2019); Apax Partners' site confirms Apax funds own Authority Brands. The Yuma location itself operates under a local franchisee (Esteban Escobar per the ZI flag notes) -- the PE backing sits at the franchisor level, not the local unit

parent_or_brand: Action Plumbing, Heating, Air & Electric (Salt Lake City, UT) -- same multi-state company; local owner listed as Ben Jordan
source: BBB profile and LinkedIn list Ben Jordan as owner, with alternate registered names ('Connectionz Plumbing, Heating and Air LLC', 'Connectionz Acquisition LLC') suggesting a past local restructuring, not clear PE involvement. One search result claimed the company was 'acquired by Heartland Home Services' in Dec 2020, but Heartland's own confirmed brand portfolio (Randazzo, Vredevoogd, A+Derr, Hager Fox, First Call Plumbing, Blind & Sons) is Midwest-only (MI/OH/IN/KY/WI) and does not list Action Plumbing -- this claim looks like a search artifact/false lead and could not be corroborated

company_name: Aire Serv of North Central Arizona
parent_or_brand: Aire Serv franchise system, owned by Neighborly (PE-backed -- acquired by KKR in Q1 2025, previously Harvest Partners since 2018)
source: Neighborly Brands' own site confirms Aire Serv is one of its franchise brands; Franchise Times and PR Newswire confirm Neighborly's ownership chain (Harvest Partners 2018 -> KKR 2025). Local unit operated by franchisee Tim Roth per the ZI flag notes -- PE backing sits at the franchisor level, not the local unit

parent_or_brand: American Residential Services (ARS/Rescue Rooter), owned by Charlesbank Capital Partners (with prior GI Partners investment)
source: ACHR News (2008) confirms ARS/Rescue Rooter acquired Tempe-based Goettl; Charlesbank Capital Partners' own portfolio page and Berenson & Co. press release confirm Charlesbank's ownership of ARS (2014 acquisition, reaffirmed 2023), with GI Partners having taken a majority stake in 2020. Goettl operates as a retained brand within the ARS national network
